designationHistory.indexText: Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuge was established with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's first purchase of coastal marsh in Matagorda County, Texas.

authority.citation: Land acquisition by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Land Protection Plan and Environmental Assessment - Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuge (ServCat 165844): "The refuge was established on July 8, 1983 with the initial acquisition of 1,271.15 acres"
